	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `python`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`# A comment

	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.TotalLines)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.ErrorCount)
}
